current:
Two instruments, run separately, carry the results. *Pangram* is a
commercial AI-text detector, scored segment by segment and calibrated
against each chamber's own pre-2022 record; it answers the prevalence
question. The *register instrument* is a fixed list of machine-overused
vocabulary — Kobak's excess-vocabulary style words — counted against each
chamber's own placebo-matched counterfactual; it is detector-independent,
transparent, and cheap enough to run across three decades, and it carries
the historical and social results. Construction, calibration and estimators
are specified in Materials and Methods; every number reproduces from a
committed script.
proposed: Two instruments, run separately, carry the results. *Pangram* is a commercial AI-text detector, scored segment by segment and calibrated against each chamber's own pre-2022 record; it answers the prevalence question. The *register instrument* is a fixed list of machine-overused vocabulary — Kobak's excess-vocabulary style words — counted against each chamber's own placebo-matched counterfactual; it is detector-independent, transparent, and cheap enough to run across three decades, and it carries the historical and social results. Detector results come first: calibration, prevalence, the genre ladder, and a corroborating screen. The register's history and social structure occupy the rest of the section. Construction, calibration and estimators are specified in Materials and Methods; every number reproduces from a committed script.
rationale: Context before interpretation (Gopen & Swan): the intro already names the two instruments but does not map the Results that follow, so the reader enters §4.1 without a route. Two sentences of old-before-new, no data changed.
